name: Zeptap
description: Lets AI agents see, tap, swipe and type on a real iPhone connected to a Mac. stdio relay for the Zeptap Mac app, which must be installed and running on macOS (paid app, first hour free).

ZEPTAP_BIN.description: Path to the Zeptap app binary. Defaults to /Applications/Zeptap.app/Contents/MacOS/Zeptap.
